title: oxera splendida
intro: Oxera splendida, commonly known as the 'Maori Lavender', is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its fragrance and medicinal properties, and has been traditionally used in Maori culture for its health benefits. The health benefits of Oxera splendida include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate stress, making it a popular natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Oxera splendida include sesquiterpene lactones and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
